name: Orchard: forty tree instances expand into trunk + crown entities, a graph system rains balls from a prefab, balls bounce on the trees and disappear when old

steps.message: 4 placed scene entities (sun, ground, camera, spawner) and 40 trees of 3 entities each

expect.message: one ball every 15 ticks, none old enough to go yet
balls older than seven seconds are removed, so the number alive stays around 28
every ball is a complete prefab copy
